records.knowledge_record: KR-W08-a: NiTexturingProperty baseTextureIndex (engine stage index) vs IR baseSlot.source (source ref) are DIFFERENT FIELDS
records.source_build: W08 engine oracle: stock Gamebryo 1.2 helper on 457485_adapted.nif (fixture SHA 1014238EB5F156A977676223E84A7A4674C89CE3097BDC8F0459824A944C9623; original 457485.nif SHA 72479A7F4EEBE93401708FC539D153B6F865DD29D04490C8E1243C0BA72B2239) vs JS IR src/pesource/NifModelReader.js parseWitnessModel on the ORIGINAL
records.claim_status: CONFIRMED DIFFERENT FIELDS, not a data mismatch: JS IR baseSlot.source = -1 (NULL source ref) while engine NiTexturingProperty::GetBaseTextureIndex() = 0. The engine accessor returns the texture STAGE INDEX (0 = BASE stage) for a present-but-sourceless BASE slot; our IR records the source *ref*. Registry rule: for an engine BASE slot, index 0 with source=-1 is NORMAL and must NOT be interpreted as a texture ref.

records.knowledge_record: KR-W03-c: ISO_5_1_0_0 50.bnt uses BUNT framing - 51,920 regular filename-xy tiles + 1 sentinel, ZERO special rows (vs PCG terrain.bnt BNT2_TERRAIN 6,530 special rows)
records.source_build: W03 full index census of the recovered ISO 50.bnt (118,016,977 B, SHA256 A6E59EE07A51EAC06A3E75DA5421E5928D59EDED74F096DCAD04CE80ED01DA00), verified before mount and re-verified in the browser
records.claim_status: CONFIRMED: BUNT footer, index @ offset 116,926,624, 51,921 entries x 21 B (13-byte name + \n + packed_size + offset), filename-xy grid 0..219 x 0..235 (51,920 regular) + 1 sentinel 7ffe7ffe.tdf; 0 duplicates, 0 bad names, 0 out-of-grid. Record framing: marker 020000ff + u32 decompressed_size + zlib (78da); BUNT packed_size counts 8 trailing bytes over (BUNT_TRAILING_BYTES - handled by true-stream slicing, re-verified per entry by strict inflate in the browser). Contrast with PCG terrain.bnt (BNT2_TERRAIN): footer BNT2, 16-byte entries with crc32, 58,451 entries including 6,530 special rows y=0xff1a..0xffff - rows that DO NOT EXIST in the ISO corpus. TDF payload: 32x32 u16 LE @ offset 64, data_size=2100, dim=32, payload 3652 B.
records.limitation: ISO 50.bnt bytes are byte-identical to the JUL_2003 copy (same SHA256) - recorded as BYTE COINCIDENCE, not an era alias (era = physical source + label). TDF offsets come from the audited fixture, not blind +/-4.
